Native Resolution Warning Your host may not support the native resolution or frame rate of this screen. With Apollo you do not need a custom display mode on the PC. Apollo scales your desktop to the requested size, or creates a virtual display at exactly this size when a virtual display is used, so your monitor is never driven in an unsupported mode. Other hosts may need a matching custom resolution on the PC, which only you can set up there. Video frame rate Increase for a smoother video stream.
